en.headline: Merchant jailed 5 years 4 months for attempted murder of wife and daughters
en.dek: A High Court judge described the Tuen Mun charcoal-burning case as tragic, noting the defendant’s depression and that he later extinguished the fire himself.
body: A 45-year-old merchant was sentenced on Monday to five years and four months in prison after pleading guilty to four counts of attempted murder of his wife and three daughters.

The High Court heard that Wong Pak-ting spiked the family’s dinner with sleeping pills and lit charcoal in their Shan King Estate flat in Tuen Mun on 25 June 2024, saying he feared debt collectors would harass them after his food-distribution business ran into difficulties. He later put out the fire and left the flat. The judge accepted that the family suffered no lasting physical or mental harm and that Wong acted while affected by depression.

Taking an eight-year starting point and giving full credit for the guilty pleas, the sentences on all four counts were ordered to run concurrently. The judge urged the defendant to make use of available support services.

zh.headline: 商人企圖謀殺妻女判囚5年4個月 法官指本案屬悲劇
zh.dek: 45歲商人承認四項企圖謀殺罪，高等法院法官指被告受抑鬱影響，後來自行熄滅炭火，並無對家人造成長遠身心傷害。
body: 45歲商人黃栢廷周一在高等法院因四項企圖謀殺罪被判入獄5年4個月。
案情指，黃栢廷於2024年6月25日在屯門山景邨單位為家人準備晚餐時混入安眠藥，其後燃點炭火，稱因生意欠債近90萬元，擔心收數人滋擾家人。他後來自行淋熄炭火並離開單位。法官游德康接納被告受抑鬱影響，家人亦無長遠身心傷害。
法官以8年為量刑起點，因被告認罪予以全數扣減，四罪同期執行，並寄語被告善用社會資源處理心理問題。
